content:
nora: Canary for valkyrie-17b-int4 showing sporadic CUDA OOMs at ~180-260 gen tokens. Mostly on long summarization and multi-turn context.

ben: Paste pod snippet?

nora:
```
2026-03-18T14:12:03Z runtime: allocate 18446744070000000000 bytes failed: CUDA OOM
kv_slot: alloc_attempts=4, contiguous_alloc_fail=true
serving: eviction requested but compaction skipped
```

leyla: That unsigned overflow value again + slot allocator failing -> fragmentation + unsafe alloc calc. What are model defaults?

nora: Catalog: max_new_tokens=400, continuous_batching=true, max_batch_size=28. Canary traces show many full-length requests.

sam: Short term plan: 1) set variant default max_new_tokens=120; 2) soft-start max_batch_size=6 for canary; 3) enable slot_compactor with run_interval=25s; 4) run `runtimectl defrag --gpu=all` in low-traffic window.

ben: Also add an allocator guard: cap requested allocation to available_gpu_mem - safety_margin and emit telemetry counter contiguous_alloc_fail. I'll open small runtime PR.

nora: Pushed canary config. infra-bot: deploy/valkyrie-17b-int4-canary started (id: dpl-20260318-21) :rocket:

leyla: If failures persist, route failing requests to valkyrie-17b-int8-compat via runtime routing policy until allocator patch lands. Also schedule quick A/B on RLHF set to check int8 quality delta.

sam: Medium-term: evaluate buddy allocator fallback or hybrid slab/buddy for large requests, and add soft-padding in allocation logic to avoid off-by-one spill that causes unsigned overflow.

nora: Ran stress with reduced defaults: 60m, zero OOMs, latency stable. Will keep canary at these defaults for 8h and then consider promote. Uploading slabmap and allocator trace to ticket for postmortem.

infra-bot: deploy/valkyrie-17b-int4-canary status: 3/3 healthy after config changes :white_check_mark:

ben: Thanks team — follow-ups: PR for guard+telemetry, SRE defrag window, and RFC for buddy fallback.
